quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: Merck's Remigromig, a Tri-specific Agonist of the (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Topline results of the pivotal Phase 2b/3 BRUNELLO trial, the first of two Phase 2b/3 trials of remigromig (MK-3000) in diabetic macular edema: at 52 weeks both doses (0.5 mg and 0.8 mg) independently showed non-inferiority to 0.5 mg ranibizumab in mean change in best-corrected visual acuity and were generally well tolerated, while proliferative diabetic retinopathy, vitreous hemorrhage and discontinuations for adverse events were higher than with ranibizumab, with further analyses underway. EyeBio CEO David Guyer: the first new mechanism of action in 20 years to achieve Phase 3 results non-inferior to anti-VEGF therapy.
